title: This was an excellent...
text: This was an excellent cruise around Barcelona! It was great to see the city from the ocean and liked the small group. The boat did not feel crowded and Miguel was a great captain! It felt like our own personal cruise! About 2 hours long, perfect at 6:30 start time in September to catch a great sunset.
author: Eileen_M

title: My Barcelona Sailing Tour immediately captivated me.
text: My Barcelona Sailing Tour immediately captivated me. The boat was very clean and comfortable. The water for swimming was amazing, and the captain prepared great drinks for us. The atmosphere was very pleasant, and I think it is perfect for spending time with friends and family! A truly amazing experience, it is definitely worth doing!

title: The Barcelona sailing experience was truly amazing!

title: Unforgettable Sailing Experience with Cool Sailing BCN
text: Cool Sailing BCN provides an outstanding sailing experience in Barcelona. The crew is professional, friendly, and attentive, making everyone feel comfortable and safe onboard. The boats are in excellent condition, and the routes offer breathtaking views of the city skyline and the Mediterranean Sea. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced sailor, the crew expertly tailor the experience to your skill level, ensuring fun and learning. The atmosphere is relaxed and enjoyable, perfect for friends, family, or solo travelers. Overall, Cool Sailing BCN delivers a memorable adventure on the water

title: Lovely Barcelona experience
text: This was a lovely experience with Miquel out on the sea in his yacht. We were only a small group which meant we could chat easily with Miquel and the other couple who joined us. We had drinks and a snack and were lucky to have a fabulous sunset over Barcelona. This was one of our favourite experiences in Barcelona and highly recommend
author: Z6817WWannad

title: Amazing experience
text:
Miquel was an amazing skipper. He was welcoming, kind, knowledgable and engaging. Hearing his stories about sailing, as well as his career before were a wonderful opportunity to learn more. He made the adventure a standout part of my trip to Spain. 

While the weather is outside his control, it was a perfect day to sail the Mediterranean, which made it even better. 

I’d recommend this experience to anyone looking for a different view of Barcelona for 90 minutes.
author: Christopher_H

title: Amazing Sailing Trip
text: I had an amazing time sailing with Miguel. Being on a smaller boat with less people and being able to jump in the sea and swim was such a great experience. I felt safe and well taken care of. I would highly recommend sailing with Miguel. Five stars!
